newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 30.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories Monday:
* Chrysler Corp and United Automobile Workers union reach three-year contract similar to union's recent agreement with Ford Motor Co.
* Lowe & Partners/SMS of Interpublic Group of Cos Inc has agreed to acquire the New York advertizing agency Goldsmith/Jeffrey.

* The $443 billion 1997 spending bill that the U.S. House of Representatives passed and the Senate is expected to pass would make the 104th Congress one of the most parsimonious in the country's history.
* The U.S. administration is expanding its property exchanges to take environmentally sensitive lands out of the hands of private owners.

* Finance ministers from rich and poor countries formally endorsed a plan to lighten the debt burden of the poorest nations. Creditor nations are to forgive about 25 percent of the debt owed by poor countries if they adopt free market economies.
